verdict.rationale: Gladia's docs state language coverage only as counts: '100+ languages' for the default solaria-1 model on its models page, and '100 target languages' for translation. They also reference configuring an explicit language list for code-switching, which implies a defined set exists. No concrete enumerated list appears in the evidence, and no per-model or per-feature language differences are spelled out beyond these counts. missing for 10: an actual published list of supported languages, explicit per-model language coverage (e.g., Solaria-3 vs Solaria-1), per-feature language differences (live vs async, diarization, PII, translation source/target).
